meta.description: Final video approval via Telegram + Studio preview. Publish only after VIDEO_APPROVED + approval row. Respects DRY_RUN/AUTO_PUBLISH on worker.

parameters.content:
## Absolute publish rule

Worker enforces:
- `AUTO_PUBLISH=false` (default)
- `DRY_RUN=true` until you flip it
- Consumed `video_approvals` row required
- Idempotent youtube_video_id check

Wire Telegram credential in n8n UI only.
